module.description: The Popover renderer and its options.
module.name: popover

ui.guidance: The panel is a native popover opened declaratively with popovertarget, so its content discloses with no script at all - a script-toggled panel would leave arbitrary caller content permanently display:none without one. The platform supplies light dismiss, Escape and the top layer; the Alpine component adds only the focus handling and keeps aria-expanded in step, because a declarative popovertarget button does not write that attribute and an expandable button that never reports its state is a bug.
ui.keyboard: Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the trigger. A popover holds arbitrary content, so it makes no promise about arrow or typeahead navigation inside it: those keys belong to whatever the panel contains, and a menu that needs them is DropdownMenu.
ui.name: popover
ui.summary: Renders a trigger with a positioned panel.
